title: Reproduce: Blood Pressure and Cardiovascular Disease Mortality Among US Adults: A Sex-Stratified Analysis, 1999-2019
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 37254774 (Blood Pressure and Cardiovascular Disease Mortality Among US Adults: A Sex-Stratified Analysis, 1999-2019) using NHANES or its governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the clinical-research workflow of PMID 37254774: Blood Pressure and Cardiovascular Disease Mortality Among US Adults: A Sex-Stratified Analysis, 1999-2019. Primary endpoint: cardiovascular disease mortality among US adults. Use NHANES or a locked benchmark extract derived from it. Report cohort construction, variables, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.
endpoint: cardiovascular disease mortality among US adults
rediscovery_target: Recover trajectory classes and their adjusted hazard ratios.
new_discovery_target: Test whether visit-to-visit variability adds signal beyond mean blood pressure.
